build_causal_node: build a Node instance with a DistributionModule and optional parent nodes for a causal graph
create_gaussian_distribution: create a Gaussian Haiku module that maps inputs into a normal distribution with MLP parameterization
create_gaussian_mixture: create a GaussianMixture module that maps inputs into a mixture of normals with configurable components
create_multinomial_distribution: create an MLPMultinomial module from a pandas dataframe column for categorical variable modeling
populate_nodes: populate observed values for a list of causal graph nodes from a dataframe
